description: Unofficial fan art of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic, the human ninja from One-Punch Man. A fully clothed companion tying boot laces, arranging a purple scarf, carefully fanning and stacking soft green leaves, recovering a loose scarf end, making a cushioned hop, and running with articulated human strides. No weapons or attacks. Original choreography with simplified guard panels; no official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
